articles.title: Modern military medieval sandbox Kingmakers gets a release date this October

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Earlier this week, one of my industry peers James Bentley (they're over at that other site about PC games, GamerPCs I think it's called) put out a video essay titled "I Can Guarantee You This Game is Going to be Underrated". Trusting in James as a critic of varied and interesting taste, I clicked through and found that yeah, they're right, it probably will be. However, I also get to write about indie PC games for a living, so I'd like to do my part in telling you about this strange, point-and-click/ visual novel called Decade.

 
Read more
articles.title: Send kids to the past to save the world from a metallic rain hellscape in the captivating point-and-click Decade

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
I think there might be a chance, just ever so slightly, that the development of Cities Skylines 2 has been a bit difficult. The game launched back in October of 2023 and has suffered from performance issues, rushed DLC, and a delay to its first expansion Bridges and Ports. This expansion was meant to come soon after the Beach Properties DLC, but that obviously didn't happen, catching a delay to sometime in the second quarter of 2025 specifically to continue improving upon the base game. Except the expansion has been delayed once again.

 
Read more
articles.title: You should forget about Cities Skyline 2's Bridges & Ports expansions for a while, because it's been delayed again

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
MindsEye isn't a real game, right? I mean, I'm sure it is a real game, it's meant to be coming out June 10th, that's only two weeks away now, and GTA 3 to 5 producer Leslie Benzies is helming it. It just doesn't feel like a real game. Take for instance the fact that the game's latest trailer, which was released today, is its first proper gameplay trailer. There's been a few teasers over the past few weeks, but absolutely zero extended looks at the shooter. That's weird for a game due out in two weeks!

 
Read more
articles.title: Sorry MindsEye, even with your first actual gameplay trailer I still don't believe you're a real game

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
As someone who's never played a Dragon Quest game, seeing Dragon Quest III HD-2D Remake last year confused me simply because I didn't know it was a prequel. I generally prefer to play things in release order, but I understand why Square Enix did it that way around, and why they subsequently announced a double remake of the first two games. The third one launched just last November, leaving 1 and 2 with a vague 2025 release window. Well, until today, when Square Enix shared that the pair of remakes will be launching October 30th.

 
Read more
articles.title: Dragon Quest 1 & 2 HD2D Remake will complete the Erdrick Trilogy when they launch this October

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
A new Assassin's Creed Shadows update is here, version 1.0.5, with this one mostly having a focus on parkour improvements. There are, however, a couple of collaborations that have arrived in the game too, one with Dead by Daylight, and another with Balatro. We'll get to those in a second, for now let's take a look at those parkour tweaks. 

 
Read more
articles.title: Assassin's Creed Shadow's latest update adds in collabs with Dead by Daylight and Balatro, of all things

articles.author: Nic Reuben
articles.description:
You may remember that in January of 2022, A. A. Milne's Winnie-the-pooh stories entered the public domain, inspiring deeply crap ideas like "what if children's character but knives?" in the case of Blood And Honey , and "what if children's character but mildly naughty word?", in the case of smirking billboardian human doppelganger Ryan Reynolds. Videogames were not immune. "What if children's character but Cronenbergian body horror?" asked the developers of Winnie's Hole when they announced a roguelike dungeon crawler based on the bear in 2023, and there's now a Steam demo available, should you wish to scoop up honey with arms-where-no-arms-should-rightly-be.
 
Read more
articles.title: Cronenbergian bear mutator Winnie's Hole gets a Steam demo

articles.author: Nic Reuben
articles.description:
Last week's Warhammer Skulls brought announcements for a new Mechanicus 2 ally faction, a strategy remaster in the form of the first Dawn Of War and all expansions, and a free Boltgun typing game in which you tap out phrases like 'emperor' and 'thin your paints' to chainsword cultists. Nestled away in the recesses of that skull, like a coiled snake on a tattoo with the name of someone's pug on it, was a teaser for the next Total War: Warhammer 3 DLC. Here's that teaser.
Read more
articles.title: Total War: Warhammer 3 fans reckon they've already guessed which faction is coming next in Tides Of Torment

articles.author: Brendan Caldwell
articles.description:
The dirt-speckled WRC racing games that were dumped by Electronic Arts a few weeks ago have already found a new partner in Nacon. The French publishers are promising a "complete reboot" of the rally game series, and have exclusive rights on the grubby wheelspinners until at least 2032. This isn't the first time the publisher have had stewardship of the WRC either, so it all kinda makes sense.
Read more
articles.title: The WRC games rally behind a new publisher weeks after being dumped by EA

articles.author: Nic Reuben
articles.description:
I woke up at 6 AM and wrote an entire news article yesterday before realising it was a bank holiday, only noticing when I entered the treehouse to find nothing but a solitary squirrel gnawing on a discarded Snickers. Today, that squirrel is dead, and it is time to work again. Here's a hissing tide of PC games slithering their way out of non-existence this week.
 Read more
articles.title: This week in PC games: Elden Ring Nightreign and a giantess dating sim

articles.author: Nic Reuben
articles.description:
Hello reader who is also a reader, and welcome back to Booked For The Week - our regular Sunday chat with a selection of cool industry folks about books! I am still cross-referencing my way through Blood Meridian, both incredibly vivid prose-poetic alchemy of the profound and harrowingly mundane, and also a bit like if a bible ate a pulp paperback then shat out a second, stupider bible with at least twice the people getting severed dicks shoved in their mouths. I love literature so much.
 Read more
articles.title: What's on your bookshelf?: Civilization, Old World, and Offworld Trading Company's Soren Johnson

articles.author: Graham Smith
articles.description:
Sundays are for doing all the errands and prep you won't have time for in the week because it's half-term. But we can also sneak in some downtime for reading and watching fine video games writing.

Criticism is cruelty, writes game developer Oma Keeling. This isn't an argument against criticism, but a plea for a more honest embrace of why we write and enjoy writing critically. As someone who, through The Sunday Papers, seems to forever be arguing for a more ruthless games press, I appreciated this.

 
Read more
articles.title: The Sunday Papers

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Almost a year on from its initial release, Zenless Zone Zero version 2.0 has been announced, slated for release next month on June 6th. There's a lot coming in this new update, namely a new area to head to, the Waifei Peninsula, a "remote yet vibrant district of New Eridu." The story follows on from where the Sacrifice crisis was left off in previous chapters, seeing you "uncover the hidden secrets of Phaethon and experience new Hollow exploration gameplay that harnesses the forces of Ether."

 
Read more
articles.title: Zenless Zone Zero version 2.0 is coming next month with a new city, 3D platforming and management minigames, and more

articles.title: Kam kráčí Mageia: po dalších 7 letech se příliš nepohnula a je to dobře

articles.title: Hacky pro Python: vlastní infixové operátory

articles.title: Brány Skeldalu na Linuxu, PartyDeck umí rozdělit obrazovku pro dvě hry

articles.title: Už neprogramuju, nedobrovolně jsem se povýšil do vedení, říká Richard Stallman

articles.title: Problematika ukazatelů v překladačích jazyka C pro systém DOS

articles.title: Borderlands 2 zdarma na Steamu

articles.title: Vznikl Xlibre Xserver jako fork Xorg?

Nauč se přemýšlet jako programátor a efektivně využívat Python na řešení nejrůznějších problémů. Online Python Akademie znamená celkem 6 měsíců studia jednou týdně nebo tři měsíce dvakrát týdně. articles.title: Pavel Bašta z CZ.NIC byl jmenován do Síně slávy Cybersecurity

Využíva pritom svoje popredné modely Gemini AI. Táto funkcia je dostupná v rámci vyhľadávania a poskytuje stručné zhrnutia článkov a informácií na základe zadaných kľúčových slov.
articles.title: Google celosvetovo zavádza AI Overviews

Po mnoho let byl členem technické komise FESCo, ale nyní se rozhodl kandidovat na místo v nejvyšším orgánu projektu – Fedora Council. Mezi sedmi uchazeči o dvě místa získal nakonec nejvíce hlasů. Česká komunita tak po delší době opět má svého zástupce v nejvyšším vedení Fedory.
articles.title: Miro Hrončok byl zvolen do nejvyššího vedení projektu Fedora

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Pařížská společnost Murena oznámila vydání mobilního operačního systému /e/OS 3.0, což je systém postavený na Androidu, který ale neobsahuje podporu služeb spojených se společností Google. Více se dozvíte v našem článku Operační systém /e/: Android bez Googlu na starém telefonu.
articles.title: Mobilní systém /e/OS 3.0 má vylepšenou rodičovskou kontrolu a nové nástroje pro ochranu soukromí

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Ctrl+P)
articles.description: Patrik Šoma zveřejnil na Portálu občana petici za povinné zveřejnění zdrojových kódů softwaru použitých ve veřejné správě. Petice vyzývá k zavedení povinného zveřejňování zdrojových kódů veškerého softwaru používaného ve veřejné sféře s výjimkou systémů přímo spojených s bezpečností státu.
articles.title: Petice za povinné zveřejnění zdrojových kódů softwaru použitých ve veřejné správě

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: unextro)
articles.description: Španělský startup Liberux spustil kampaň na Indiegogo pro výrobu výkonného linuxového telefonu Liberux Nexx poháněného 8jádrovým Rockchip RK3588S CPU s 32 GB RAM, 512GB úložištěm a 6,34″ 2400×1080 OLED displejem.
articles.title: Liberux spustil crowfundingovou kampaň na linuxový telefon Nexx

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Richard Hughes z Red Hatu oznámil novou verzi nástroje Fwupd pro aktualizace firmwarů na Linuxu. Tentokrát se podpory dočkávají majitelé dokovací stanice Lenovo Thunderbolt 5 Smart Dock, nechybí ale ani obvyklá várka oprav.
articles.title: Fwupd 2.0.11 s podporou Lenovo Thunderbolt 5 Smart Dock

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: V roce 2009 dostali Dr. George E. Smith a Dr. Willard S. Boyle Nobelovu cenu za fyziku právě za objev technologie CCD snímačů. Willard S. Boyle zemřel v roce 2011 a nyní, 28. května 2025 jej George E. Smith následoval.
articles.title: Ve věku 95 let zemřel George E. Smith, spolutvůrce CCD snímačů

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Nadále roste podpora základních desek Asus v ovladači pro Asus Embedded Controller (EC) Sensors ( asus-ec-sensors). Příští verze linuxového jádra přidá na seznam podporovaných desek také modely MAXIMUS VI HERO a ROG Z690 Formula. Zatímco u Z690 jde o relativně současný model spadající do 12. generace Core, podporující CPU až po 14. generaci, MAXIMUS VI HERO je jiná káva. Tato deska je z 4. generace Core zvané „Haswell“, s čipsetem Z87. Na trh přišla před 12 lety.
articles.title: Jádro Linux 6.16 přinese hardwarový monitoring pro další desky Asus i lepší podporu AMD Zen 5

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Příští týden se v Praze uskuteční jedna z nejvýznamnějších internetových konferencí pořádaná organizací ICANN – ICANN Policy Forum. Hostitelem této vrcholné akce je sdružení CZ.NIC, pro které je čest přivítat zde opět po třinácti letech hlavní představitele celosvětové internetové komunity. Veřejná zasedání organizace ICANN jsou zdarma a přístupná všem zájemcům o internetová témata. Registrace je otevřena do 8. června 2025, přičemž je možné se účastnit i vzdáleně.
articles.title: Příští týden proběhne v Praze setkání ICANN Policy Forum

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Bezpečnostní odborníci zjistili, že sledovací kódy, které Meta a ruský Yandex vkládají do milionů webových stránek, dovolují deanonymizovat návštěvníky zneužitím legitimních internetových protokolů. Výsledkem je, že z prohlížečů v Androidu sbírají jedinečné identifikátory a ty pak předávají aplikacím nainstalovaným v zařízení.
articles.title: Společnosti Meta a Yandex párují na Androidu chování v prohlížečích s identitami uživatelů

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: Linuxových systémů přibývá, každý den se spouštějí nové servery a někdo se o ně musí starat. To znamená spoustu různých dovedností specifických právě pro linuxové prostředí. Jak to zprovoznit, kudy bezpečně dovnitř, co tam najdeme, jak se o to postaráme a jak to nastavíme nebo rozšíříme.
articles.title: Naučte se používat Linux správně a bezpečně (školení)

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Svatopluk Vít)
articles.description: Na webové stránce společnosti RocketTheme se objevila dnes už asi nepřekvapivá zpráva, že k 30. červnu tohoto roku ukončuje svou činnost. RocketTheme byl známý tvůrce doplňků a šablon pro redakční systémy Joomla, WordPress a Grav. Svou činnost ukončuje po dvaceti letech fungování.
articles.title: RocketTheme po dvaceti letech tvorby webových šablon ukončí svou činnost

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Do vývojové větve jádra, z níž vzejde Linux 6.16, byl začleněn nový ovladač Intel Overclocking Watchdog (OC WDT). Kód původně vyvinutý jedním z inženýrů Siemensu byl dotažen do fáze, kdy přináší obecné vylepšení funkcionality pro Linux, srovnatelné s tím, co nabízí Intel na Windows: propojení na hardwarovou výbavu čipsetů pro lepší monitorování stavu systému při přetaktování.
articles.title: Ovladač Intel Overclocking Watchdog v jádru Linux 6.16

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: johny)
articles.description: Dnes, 3. júna 2025, odštartovala dvojdňová online konferencia IntelliJ IDEA Conf 2025, ktorá prináša 15 živých prednášok od špičkových odborníkov v oblasti softvérového vývoja.
articles.title: Konferencia IntelliJ IDEA 2025: Novinky a trendy v softvérovom vývoji

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Wine nadále směřuje k vydání verze 11.0, přičemž dalším krokem na cestě je 10.9. Ta aktualizuje knihovnu VKD3D na verzi 1.16, přidává počáteční podporu generování Windows Runtime metadat v rámci WIDL a v neposlední řadě pak vylepšenou podporu Clangu.
articles.title: Vývojová verze Wine 10.9 s EGL pro všechny

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Společnost Google oznámila, že její prohlížeč už nebude důvěřovat certifikátům vydaným společnostmi Chunghwa Telecom a Netlock. Zdůvodňuje to „znepokojivým chováním pozorovaným v uplynulém roce“. Očekává se, že změna bude zavedena v prohlížeči Chrome 139, jehož vydání je naplánováno na začátek letošního srpna.
articles.title: Chrome přestane důvěřovat dvěma certifikačním autoritám kvůli porušování pravidel

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: Jak se pandemie COVID-19, inflace a válka na Ukrajině – jakožto největší výzvy první poloviny tohoto desetiletí – podepsaly na počtu domén druhého řádu pod .cz, počtu českých držitelů a na celkovém objemu provozu? Analýza projektu ADAM ukazuje, že zmíněné faktory ovlivnily českou doménovou scénu různými způsoby.
articles.title: Vliv velkých krizí z první poloviny desetiletí na doménu .cz

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Společnost Google vydala narychlo mimo plán opravy, které řeší tři bezpečnostní problémy v prohlížeči Chrome. U jedné z chyb už byly zaznamenány případy zneužití. Jde o problém s označením CVE-2025–5419 a jde o práci s pamětí mimo vymezené hranice (out-of-bounds) v enginu V8 JavaScript a WebAssembly. Chyba umožňuje zaútočit na paměť prohlížeče pomocí upravené HTML stránky.
articles.title: V Chrome je aktivně zneužívaná vážná zranitelnost, vyšla nouzová záplata mimo plán

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Před pár dny byla v tichosti vydána nová verze Rawtherapee 5.12. V nástroji Raw Black Points je nová volba Dehaze, která nastaví černý bod na minimální hodnotu ve fotografii, což obvykle vede ke zmenšení oparu. Distortion Correction dostává schopnost předělat fotky z rybího oka na klasickou rektilineární projektu, příslušné nastavovátko v Lens/Geometry pak umožňuje ruční doladění, pokud by automatika nedala uspokojivý výsledek.
articles.title: Rawtherapee 5.12 s kompresí gamutu, korekcí rybího oka či rámečky

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Údajné důkazy mimozemského života si stále zasluhují skepsi. Na okraji Sluneční soustavy možná našli dosud neznámou trpasličí planetu. Infračervené kontaktní čočky umožňují vidět ve tmě i se zavřenýma očima. Plzeň úspěšně vyzkoušela novou technologii pro monitoring vzdušného prostoru, odhalila nelegální lety s drony. Běžná antidepresiva by mohla pomáhat imunitnímu systému proti rakovině.
articles.title: Týden na ScienceMag.cz: Vědci objevují neznámé molekuly s pomocí AI

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Nová řada firewallů společnosti Fortinet nabízí pokročilou detekci hrozeb a zmírnění rizik umělé inteligence. Automatizace s využitím AI překlenuje propast mezi inovacemi a regulací. S řešením agrese na školách pomohou kamery s umělou inteligencí. Kritické zranitelnosti zůstávají ve firmách neopravené měsíce. Jak modernizovat starší Microsoft software a zpeněžit nadbytečné licence? Omnissa potvrzuje kontinuitu a má vysoké ambice. A(I)-Z v automobilovém průmyslu: jakou roli bude hrát umělá inteligence?
articles.title: Týden na ITBiz: Kritické zranitelnosti zůstávají ve firmách neopravené měsíce

articles.description: Školní rok pomalu končí a prázdniny a dovolené klepají na dveře. Pojďte se v klidu připravit na budoucnost a naučit se pracovat s novým softwarem. articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: HotDOGy vs. Dysonovy sféry: 7 kandidátů na mimozemskou technologii. Feynmanův zákon a fraktální geometrie katastrof. Neexistuje pouze nekov, nebo kov, ale také přepínající se fáze. Rané galaxie přispívají k dosvitu vesmíru. V Česku vznikla biobanka dřeně dětských zubů pro uchování kmenových buněk. Povedlo se najít vztah mezi neurčitostí obsaženou v kvantovém měření a kvantovou provázaností.

Tellur zvyšuje výkon 2D polovodičů. GFI Software: prudký nárůst objemu dat zvyšuje rizika deepfake útoků. Firmy chtějí ukládat data lokálně, ale s globálním zabezpečením. HPE uvádí portfolio pro privátní cloud s inovacemi pro podnikové hybridní IT.

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Acer představuje nové Copilot+ PC notebooky. Nintendo Switch 2 se blíží. Co přinese a jak změní trh? Investice do datových center se v roce 2024 meziročně zdvojnásobily a přiblížily se hodnotě 50 miliard dolarů. Izraelská společnost Cato Networks ztrojnásobí kapacitu svého pražského vývojového centra. Huawei Demo Truck opět v Praze: představí sítě budoucnosti a AI scénáře v praxi. Růst evropských výdajů na bezpečnost souvisí i s regulačními požadavky. Mobilní síť bude inteligentní: od 5G k 6G. Revoluce v bezdrátových sítích: firmy se již nyní musí začít připravovat na Wi-Fi 7, přinese nové možnosti.

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Last month Intel software engineers began posting Linux enablement patches for Wildcat Lake. Some of those first patches were merged for Linux 6.16 while more work is forthcoming. Posted yesterday for the first time on the Linux kernel mailing list was enabling the NPU accelerator support for Wildcat Lake...
articles.title: Intel Linux Driver Patch Posted For Wildcat Lake NPU Accelerator Support

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Since recently picking up a Qualcomm Snapdragon X Elite laptop for Linux testing now that the Linux support is starting to evolve into better shape (albeit still with many rough corners limiting the daily usability of such devices with Linux), one of the areas I was curious about was looking at the performance of Linux binaries with GCC vs. LLVM Clang. Here are some benchmarks for those wondering how the GCC and Clang compilers are competing on the Snapdragon X Elite with the Oryon CPU cores.
articles.title: Qualcomm Snapdragon X1 Elite GCC vs. LLVM Clang Compiler Performance

articles.description: Just a few days after the FEX 2506 release for that open-source emulator enabling x86_64 binaries to run on ARM64 (AArch64) hosts, Box64 is out with its newest feature update for this open-source project with similar goals...

articles.description: While the AMD Ryzen AI Max+ Strix Halo SoCs have a nice out-of-the-box experience with modern Linux distributions for the Radeon 8050S and Radeon 8060S graphics, if going for the recently-released Linux 6.15 kernel there are some performance gains to enjoy as well as if opting for the latest Mesa 25.2 development code for the latest RadeonSI OpenGL and RADV Vulkan driver support...
articles.title: The Performance Gains Brought By Linux 6.15+ & Mesa 25.2 For AMD Strix Halo

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Following all of the Linux kernel graphics driver features merged last week for the Linux 6.16 kernel, sent out this morning were the initial batch of fixes to the Direct Rendering Manager (DRM) code. Besides fixes to these graphics / display / accelerator drivers, there is one new feature: the AMDKFD kernel compute driver can now be enabled on RISC-V systems...
articles.title: AMD's Kernel Compute Driver "AMDKFD" Can Now Be Enabled On RISC-V

articles.title: Apple M2 Pro / Max / Ultra PCIe Support Upstreamed In Linux 6.16

articles.title: Linux 6.16 NFS Client Exposes LOCALIO State Via sysfs

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Following the Intel TDX host support for KVM being merged for the Linux 6.16 merge window, another batch of Kernel-based Virtual Machine (KVM) changes were merged for the ongoing Linux 6.16 merge window...
articles.title: More KVM Changes Merged For Linux 6.16: AMD "ALLOWED_SEV_FEATURES" Merged

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Mesa's modern Rust-written OpenCL driver for Gallium3D "Rusticl" has closed one of the few remaining gaps with the former Clover OpenCL state tracker. Merged today for Mesa 25.2 is native FP16 support...
articles.title: Mesa's Rusticl Lands OpenCL FP16 Half-Float Support

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: As some extra benchmarks to put out today for the Phoronix.com 21st birthday, there is some additional data points to share on AMD Strix Halo when using Linux 6.15 stable and the early development state of Linux 6.16 Git ahead of its v6.16-rc1 tagging this weekend. The Linux kernel performance is moving in the right direction at least with this round of testing using the HP ZBook Ultra G1a with Ryzen AI Max+ PRO SoC...
articles.title: Linux 6.15 & Early Linux 6.16 Delivering Some Additional Gains For AMD Strix Halo

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: An initial patch series sent back out in April proposed PCACHE as a persistent memory cache for block devices. PCACHE was born out of the CXL block device driver and brings some benefits over the likes of BCache and dm-writecache...
articles.title: Proposed Persistent Cache For Block Devices "PCACHE" Ported To DM Framework

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: FreeBSD developers have been working a lot on their wireless/WiFi driver support in recent months as part of their broader initiative for improving their operating system support for laptops. While a lot of progress has been made on seeing more modern WiFi support and recent WiFi chipsets being enabled, it's still not complete and that puts FreeBSD 15 in a tough position. FreeBSD 15 is set to be released later this year and will likely declare their wireless support as "unstable" to allow time for making future breaking modifications...
articles.title: FreeBSD Developers Deciding What To Do For WiFi With FreeBSD 15: Stable Or Unstable

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Last month I began the much anticipated AMD Strix Halo Linux benchmarking at Phoronix by testing the top-end Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 395 that features 16 cores / 32 threads and the very impressive Radeon 8060S integrated graphics. Coming in one step below that flagship Strix Halo SoC is the Ryzen AI Max (PRO) 390 with Radeon 8050S graphics. Coming out today on Phoronix - coincidentally timed for the 21st birthday of Phoronix.com - is the first benchmarks of the Ryzen AI Max PRO 390 along with the Radeon 8050S graphics.
articles.title: AMD Radeon 8050S "Strix Halo" Linux Graphics Performance

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: For some very fun Linux benchmarking on this 21st anniversary of starting Phoronix is looking at the Ryzen AI Max (PRO) 390 Linux performance, the 12-core Strix Halo SoC with Radeon 8050S Graphics. While there have been various benchmarks of the AMD Ryzen AI Max+ (PRO) 395 in recent weeks on Phoronix and other publications, the other Ryzen AI Max "Strix Halo" SoCs haven't been as widely seen in the industry yet. The 12-core Ryzen AI Max PRO 390 was tested within another HP ZBook Ultra G1a for a very interesting look at the high-end/premium Linux laptop/workstation performance.
articles.title: AMD Ryzen AI Max 390 Performance - 12-Core Strix Halo

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Phoronix has made it another year. Today marks 21 years since I started Phoronix.com with a focus on providing Linux hardware reviews. Linux hardware support is a night and day difference then to today as is the overall ecosystem with all the major hardware vendors these days having some -- often significant -- levels of interest in Linux support. No longer is it typically a worry of whether your mouse, 56K modem, WiFi adapter, or other basic peripherals working but most often just a matter of how well the performance is on Linux, whether there is LVFS/Fwupd firmware updating support, and if other non-show-stopping features are supported. We still haven't managed the "year of the Linux desktop" but it's been wild with Chrome OS and Android being based on Linux, Linux coming to dominate the server world, Linux being ubiquitous to cloud computing, and Valve revolutionizing the Linux gaming space...
articles.title: Marking 21 Years Of Covering Linux Hardware

3, 2, 1, go! Mario Kart World's racetracks are bigger than ever, and it's all because of an open world to explore in the all-new Free Roam mode.


Mario Kart World gives players more freedom than ever in the franchise, opening up the map in Free Roam mode for everyone to drive around, practice new movement mechanics like wall ride and rail ride, find collectibles, and just have fun.


Here's everything you need to know about how to play Free Roam mode in Mario Kart World on Nintendo Switch 2.


How to Free Roam in Mario Kart World


Screenshot and remix by Destructoid


To play Free Roam in Mario Kart World, when at the main menu, press the + button. This will immediately and seamlessly let you take control of the character driving through the open world in the background.


When in Free Roam, press the Y button to open up the world map. From here, you can instantly fast travel to any of the tracks on the map or select any of the characters on the map to switch to them and play as them immediately.


When you hover over a racetrack, you can see how many secrets it has and how many you've collected, like the "?" panels you can drive over. You can do the same with each character to see how many costumes you've unlocked for them.


The Free Roam map also has Dash Food at drive-thrus scattered around the world that you can pick up. When you use Dash Food, it has the potential to change your character's appearance and unlock new outfits and a new racer featuring said outfit.


Screenshot by Destructoid


There are also P-Switch challenges and Peach Medallions to be found throughout the world, so make sure to keep your eyes peeled (like a banana in the road) to spot everything you can while you explore the wonderful map.

articles.description:
If you load into Mario Kart World's freeroam mode and explore the map, chances are you will come across a P Switch or two now and again that tasks you with a mission to unlock an item, usually one of the various Stickers.


The P Switch is easy to find, but also incredibly annoying to find, as once you claim one, it doesn't appear on the map, greyed out for you to share information or appear on the map at all. You can just come across one randomly, try the mission, fail it, move on to another area, and then, when you try to find it again, you completely blank where it was.


To start a P Switch mission, you need to drive into it. The task will then appear briefly, and you'll have a set amount of time to complete the task. If the timer reaches zero, you'll be given an option to reset the quest where you started or drive on and not bother with it for the time being.


Screenshot by Destructoid


In total, there are over 125 P Switches to find throughout the world. 129 to be specific, though it's possible we might have missed a few here or there. It's hard to tell and keep track, and I might update the article in the future with a static figure once we lock it in.


As for where to locate them, we will need to come back to that eventually. There are so many to find spread out with their each available missions that it'll be hard to have a concrete list of them all this close to launch. They are mainly meant to be found casually anyway, and as the rewards are stickers, we imagine a lot of players won't attempt to find them all and focus on racing instead.


But either way, let us know in the comments below what was the best P Switch you came across—and where it was—so we can go try it out for ourselves.

It's been a few days now since Mario Kart World's launch, so it should have been more than enough time to declare some loyalties for the new batch of characters and pick out which is your favorite, right?


Now I can already see where this is probably going to go. I'm expecting the Cow army to stampede in from Moo Moo Meadows and completely dominate the poll, which is why I have decided to allow multiple choice this time around so we can get an idea of at least who will come in second place.



There are over 24 new characters to find and unlock, with most of the new ones being tied to the new Kamek in-game item, which turns you into a random NPC when used. If used in the correct place, you can unlock the character to use permanently later down the line as well.


For me, it's great to see Hammer Bros. as a playable character finally, and it feels like this one was a long time coming. Spike, I know, is a fan-favorite character people have wanted to play for ages in Mario Kart as well, so I'm sure he will get a lot of love either in the poll or the comments below. Loads of my friends have been hyped to try and unlock him as quickly as possible.


Nabbit also strangely makes its Mario Kart debut and has been one of the standout new Mario characters to get a lot of love, even being a playable character in Super Mario Wonder recently.


I am super curious, though, to hear some of your favorites, so if you clicked on the poll to vote above, be sure to leave a comment down below to explain some of your picks, especially if it's some of the weirder characters like Fish Bone, Snowman, etc. What made them stand out to you?

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Twenty-six years ago this week, Shawn Fanning and Sean Parker launched Napster, a music sharing platform that disrupted a global industry. After being sued and declaring bankruptcy, today's Napster is a legal streaming brand. Yet, in a recent complaint, a royalty collection outfit accused Napster of "massive" copyright violations. The aim was to have the site's domain blocked by every ISP in Italy, effectively denying its ability to do business there.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Napster.com Faced ISP Piracy Blockade For “Massive Copyright Violations”

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Republican House Representative Darrell Issa is working on the introduction of the 'American Copyright Protection Act' (ACPA), a new bill that would enable copyright holders to request site blocking orders against foreign pirate sites. A discussion draft shows that the proposed framework has key differences compared to the FADPA bill introduced  by Rep. Lofgren earlier this year. Both bills target DNS resolvers, however, which has several tech companies worried. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Unveiled: New U.S. Anti-Piracy Bill ‘ACPA’ Proposes Alternative Site Blocking Path

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Before its inevitable demise, NooNooTV [NunuTV] was believed to be the largest pirate site in South Korea. That in itself made the site's operator a prime target for enforcement. Despite spawning dozens of domains to avoid blocking, and reportedly moving servers from one 'safe' country to another, local authorities continued their investigation in collaboration with INTERPOL. At a court in South Korea last week, 'Person A' was sentenced to three years in prison.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Operator of South Korea’s Largest Pirate Site Sentenced to 3 Years in Prison

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
The Motion Picture Association sees automated, real-time, and dynamic site blocking mechanisms as a key tool to fight online piracy. In response to an inquiry from the European Commission, reviewing its recommendation to combat live-streaming piracy, the MPA further notes that VPN companies and CDN providers should be actively involved. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: MPA Backs Automated Pirate Site-Blocking, Sees Role for VPN and CDN Companies

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Dutch anti-piracy group BREIN has just posted its latest annual report, highlighting several key achievements. IPTV continues to be the largest threat to the audiovisual industry. In addition to shutting down dozens of operators, BREIN made criminal referrals that it expects to pay off this year. Google also lent a helping hand by banning adverts for 'IPTV' keyword searches. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Anti-Piracy Group BREIN Ramps Up IPTV Actions Under New Leadership

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
A new Enders Analysis report describes piracy of live sports and premium TV as "industrial scale theft" that costs companies such as Sky and the Premier League billions every year. The report calls out Amazon for selling legal Fire TV devices too cheaply, while Google and Microsoft receive criticism for lacking interest in DRM. These talking points show that Enders has its finger on the industry's pulse. Founded by a veteran anti-piracy lobbyist of more than 20 years, that's to be expected.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Enders’ Piracy Report Blames Big Tech; That’s What Anti-Piracy Lobbyists Do

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Every week we take a close look at the most pirated movies on torrent sites. What are pirates downloading? 'Sinners' tops the chart, followed by 'A Minecraft Movie'. 'Fountain of Youth' completes the top three.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Top 10 Most Pirated Movies of The Week – 06/02/2025

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Several prominent record labels have settled their piracy liability lawsuit with Internet provider Frontier Communications. In a public notice, all parties agree to bear their own costs, but the details of the settlement agreement were not disclosed. The settlement arrives just weeks after a similar lawsuit filed by movie companies was settled ahead of trial. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Record Labels and ISP Frontier Settle Piracy Liability Lawsuit

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Five men found guilty of criminal copyright infringement in connection with pirate streaming site Jetflicks remain free after being convicted in 2024. In a sentencing memorandum filed at a Las Vegas court, counsel for group leader Kristopher Dallmann describes the government's loss calculations as "facially absurd" in a case featuring "an egregious incidence of the trial tax problem." The sentencing guideline range for Dallmann is an unprecedented 25 to 30 years.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: IPTV Pirate Fights 25-30 Years Prison, “Facially Absurd” U.S. Govt Calculations

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Popular stream-ripping site Yout.com has failed to have a criminal copyright complaint dismissed in Brazil. The prosecution will be allowed to continue its copyright claim against the American operator of the site, who faces a potential prison sentence. The court notes that the defense has strong arguments, but the burden of proof is low at this stage, so the case will proceed.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Brazil Advances Criminal Prosecution of American Yout.com Operator

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
A former employee of a disc manufacturing company in Memphis has signed a plea agreement, in which he admits stealing and distributing numerous DVD and Blu-ray discs. They include “Spider-Man: No Way Home,” which subsequently leaked online before its official release. As part of the agreement, the U.S. will recommend a relatively low sentence. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Employee Pleads Guilty in “Spider-Man” Pre-Release Piracy Case

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
The results of the latest consumer surveys, carried out by Mediavision in the Nordic countries, are a mixed bag of bad news, and slightly less bad news. On one hand, consumption of pirate IPTV services in Sweden has dropped two points, from 16% of all households in 2024 to 14% in 2025. On the other, 30% of over 15-year-olds consume content illegally every month, a figure that rises to over 50% among men under 35.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Pirate IPTV Consumed By 30% of Swedes, Including 50% of Men Under 35

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
The U.S. Solicitor General has urged the Supreme Court to accept Cox Communications' petition in a landmark piracy liability lawsuit. The USSG argues that ISPs are not necessarily liable for pirating subscribers and warns that the current precedent may lead to disconnections for many innocent subscribers. At the same time, the USSG urged the court to deny a petition from the opposing music companies, which seeks to expand the current liability verdict.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: U.S. Govt. Backs Cox in Landmark Supreme Court Battle Over ISP Piracy Liability

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
After months of unprecedented site-blocking controversy, LaLiga informs TorrentFreak that piracy decreased by 40% at weekends and as much as 60% for a hotly-anticipated matchup. Yet interestingly, LaLiga's view of the nationwide overblocking crisis sits in stark contrast to reports published elsewhere. Primarily, there's no hard evidence that a crisis even exists; total formal complaints received by LaLiga in its dedicated inbox: zero.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: LaLiga’s “Precise” Blocking Cut Piracy By 40-60%, “Without Collateral Impact”

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
The legal dispute between Apple and music streaming app Musi has taken another unexpected turn. Following Apple's motion for sanctions, which dismissed Musi's allegations that a backroom deal was responsible for the app's removal, Musi has countered with a detailed overview of communications between Apple, YouTube, and music industry officials, while also calling for sanctions. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Musi Alleges Apple’s App Store Removal Was Orchestrated, Seeks Sanctions

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Portugal often served as an example of how effectively pirate site blocking measures can be implemented. Internet providers are blocking more than 3,000 domain names today with relative ease. While Hollywood reported that the blocks are effective, not all rightsholders necessarily agree. In fact, new data reveals that Portugal remains a piracy hotspot in Europe.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Portugal Remains a Piracy Hotspot Despite Blocking Thousands of Sites

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Cloudflare CEO Matthew Prince issued a stark warning over LaLiga's ISP blocking campaign. The blockades deny access to less than 150 pirate sites and reportedly render millions of innocent websites unavailable. Prince said he "prays no one dies," after revealing Spanish citizens are being denied access to critical resources. Mass blocking of Cloudflare continued on Sunday, despite a clear indication from Prince that his company has always been willing to cooperate.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Cloudflare CEO: Football Piracy Blocks Will Claim Lives; “I Pray No One Dies”

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
The anti-piracy team at Kakao Entertainment likes to stand out and not just when there's good news to report. Like the avian beauty that inspired its name, P.CoK's approach is part eye-catching, part distraction, but it does appear to be working. With help from what it describes as an underground network of volunteer informants, P.CoK claims to have shut down 28 pirate sites. It also posts 'insider' evidence and items of proof to social media, to dispel any lingering doubt.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: P.CoK Webtoon Piracy Fighters Display Plumage as Unorthodox Tactics Pay Off

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Expressing grave concerns over Italy's  Piracy Shield system, this January tech and telecoms advocacy group CCIA urged the government to withdraw planned legislation and engage TRIS, an EU procedure which aims to prevent internal market barriers. In a newly submitted contribution under TRIS, CCIA urges the European Commission to issue a detailed opinion to ensure Piracy Shield's compatibility with EU law.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Piracy Shield: European Commission Urged to Assess Legality Under EU Law

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (The ScummVM Team)
articles.description:
Get ready to jam and slap da BASS!
Yes, it is this time of the year again! Please welcome the first ScummVM release of the year: ScummVM 2.9.1.
This maintenance release mainly focused on fixing bugs that our developers and users have uncovered since our last stable release.
As usual, several engines and platforms received their fair share of bug fixes and improvements: AGI, AGS, Asylum, BAGEL, Bladerunner, Hopkins, MADS, NGI, SCI, SCUMM, Sky, Sword1, Tetraedge, Tinsel, Tucker, TwinE, and TWP.
Our porters also went on a bug-hunting spree, so all we can provide is a small summary of the latest and greatest fixes!
The Nintendo 3DS (yes, we do not care about end-of-life dates!) has the GUI appropriately displayed if it is configured to use the top screen only.
Android now provides an option to save and restore your configuration file and save games, and the vast majority of older Android devices will see increased performance thanks to the ARM NEON optimizations, which are now enabled by default. And the Beneath a Steel Sky game is not crashing in the intro anymore!
The Atari port received some internal backend, GUI, and audio fixes. Speaking of audio: iOS/iPad will now always properly recognize FluidSynth soundfonts, macOS has support for Audio CD playback from original discs on Snow Leopard and earlier, and Windows 9x (yes, EOL…) can use FLAC files again!
The detailed list of improvements is available here.
Head over to our downloads page and grab it while it’s hot! As usual, macOS and Windows users can update ScummVM with our integrated, magical auto-upgrade solution.
>
articles.title: ScummVM 2.9.1 “Slappin da BASS” is here!

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (DreamMaster)
articles.description:
Robert Ripley, a famous traveler and collector of rarities. One day, during a trip in Egypt, Ripley is attacked by mysterious Chinese assassins. The trail will lead him and his Chinese girlfriend Mei Chen on a chase around the world, in a race against time to prevent the greatest theft of all time, the First Emperor's seal, which could plunge the world into chaos.
The ScummVM Team is pleased to announce full support for Ripley's Believe It Or Not! The Secret of Master Lu, the other classic game, besides Orion Burger, by Sanctuary Woods. As with Orion Burger, it adds a few niceties that the original didn't have, such as mouse wheel handling, and using the spacebar to skip walk animations.
Help us test the game by grabbing a daily build. Read through our testing guidelines. The game's logic was all hardcoded, and proved even more complicated than that of Orion Burger, so we really need people to try all sorts of weird actions, and make sure the game handles everything correctly and matches the original implementation. And please take some screenshots along the way.
Good luck. If you fail to prevent the seal falling into evil hands, it could be used to unite all Asia under a single ruler, thirsty for conquest.
>
articles.title: A new game for testing. Believe It Or Not

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (fracturehill)
articles.description:
Are you ready for more sleuthing with everyone’s favorite teenage detective? We’re excited to announce that Nancy Drew: Secret of the Scarlet Hand and Nancy Drew: Ghost Dogs of Moon Lake are now ready for public testing! Furthermore, it's now possible to enable the ScummVM save/load screens instead of the original ones, to take advantage of additional features when saving or loading.
In Nancy Drew: Secret of the Scarlet Hand, Nancy takes on the role of an intern at a Washington D.C. museum, where a mysterious theft sets off a series of clues leading deep into the secrets of ancient Maya artifacts.
In Nancy Drew: Ghost Dogs of Moon Lake, Nancy finds herself investigating a haunted cabin surrounded by eerie howls and ghostly canine apparitions.
The games are available for purchase through HeR Interactive’s website or Steam. Or if you already own a CD copy of the games, their English and Russian variants will also work. To play them with ScummVM, you will need a daily development build. As always, if you encounter any issues, please submit a bug report to our issue tracker.
>
articles.title: Two more Nancy Drew Mysteries solved!

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (sev)
articles.description:
This is yet another exciting year for the ScummVM project as we have five GSoC contributors joining the project this summer.
Ellen Moon will be continuing work on adding Text-to-Speech to more engines. This will increase accessibility for those games that were missing voice-overs. This task will be presented on Ellen's GSoC blog.
Aun Noman (known as Prime) will, at the same time, be adding Keymapper to the remaining engines. Only about 45% of ScummVM-supported engines have this feature. The current list can be found on our Wiki. And the relevant task blog will eventually be hosted at Aun's GSoC blog
Malhar Badve (aka SuperLemon) is our Director contributor for this year. He has already added more improvements to QTVR, but our overall hope for this year is to add movie saving capability, which is required by many titles. You will be able to follow the progress for this task on Malhar’s GSoC blog.
Shivang Nagta will pick up work on a system for verifying game file integrity, validating their checksums against those present in a central database. It will also let users contribute the checksums of game files not on the database. You can follow the progress for this task on Shivang’s GSoC blog.
Alikhan Balpykov will help us with completing the qdEngine implementation this year. You can follow the progress for this task on Alikhan GSoC blog.
Please give them a warm welcome, and visit our Discord server if you want to discuss those projects. After a four week Community Bounding period, the coding period will start on June 2, and you can expect regular updates on these projects on their respective blogs. The team is very excited about the upcoming summer – and we hope you are as well.
>
articles.title: Google Summer of Code 2025 – Five Participants are Joining Us This Year
